detail.lastText:
I didn't push or merge anything this time: TEAM-5251 was already done, and I found one gap that the merged fix leaves open. An earlier run delivered it as PR #767, merged into `feature/TEAM-5226-workflow-manager-analyze-dies-with-maxto` at 29e8e89f. CI is certifying that head right now (TEAM-5252), and a push would have disturbed it.

**What happened.** A parallel session pushed its own fix to `feature/TEAM-5251-bug-fixer` while mine was running. When my push was rejected, I checked: that version had already been merged and the ticket closed. I didn't force-push. My version (commit 90ad1292) is kept only in the local workspace.

**Checking the merged head (29e8e89f).**
- The merged spec, `tests/workflow-manager-panel.spec.ts`, passes 23/23.
- I also ran my own stricter sweep against it. It covers every visible text node, settles transitions first, and additionally opens the "Full report" section. Five of the six theme/state combinations pass.
- The muted text, `.wm-tag`, the header and card icons, badges and bar fills all meet the thresholds in both themes.

**The gap (light theme, all-tones state, "Full report" expanded).** The report text fails 4.5:1:

| Text | Colour on white | Ratio |
|---|---|---|
| Headings ("Summary", "Bottlenecks") | #e2e8f0 | 1.23:1 |
| Body paragraphs and list items | #94a3b8 | 2.56:1 |

- **Cause:** `src/components/workflow/pipeline.css:543-544`. The `.agent-output-prose` class used by the shared report renderer hardcodes dark-theme colours and has no light-theme version.
- **Why the merged tests miss it:** they never click the report toggle, so that text is never on the page while they measure.
- **Why it's in scope:** the ticket asks for every visible text node in the panel to pass.
- **Suggested fix:** a light-theme colour rule applied only inside the panel's report section, so the shared renderer stays unchanged. The sweep would also need to open the report before measuring.
